# W9: Intelligent Chapter Writer

## USES N8N DATA TABLES + LOCAL FILES

This workflow:
- Reads outlines from **outlines_data** table
- Saves chapters to **chapters_data** table
- Writes .md file for each chapter to **C:/dev/production_line/chapters/**

## Output Files
- chapter_{n}_{title}.md - Individual chapter files

## Cost: ~$0.03-0.08 per section
